name: Nymrissa Wavecaller — The Tidebound Grotto
source: BigWigs (BigWigsMods/BigWigs b26c019) MidnightLairs/Nymrissa.lua + Method boss guide (mechanics). Timings checked 24 Oct 2026 against Lorrgs.io (boss cast timelines of the top 50 Outlaw Rogue kills per difficulty, api2.lorrgs.io): see `checked` per difficulty.
notes: Edit freely (Fight settings > Edit…). Times are seconds after the pull. timesFrom: bigwigs = timeline durations read from BigWigs (pull timers only), guide = from the guide, assumed = my guess. 'assumed' lists effect sizes that are guesses. BigWigs matches timeline bars by rounded duration: Abyssal Rain 8/23/33, Alluring Bubble 18, bubble adds 7/25, Chilling Frost 17/35, Swirling Whirlpools 89/107, plus a 44 s bar that rotates adds -> Chilling Frost -> Abyssal Rain; Real logs show a 110 s cycle (bubble adds 23, frost 38 + 82, whirlpools 111). Not modelled: Abyssal Rain and Pop! (raid damage), Wavecaller's Might stacks and Unending Tides (enrage), Iceblade Flurry / Water Jet (tank), failed murlocs turning into Berserkers.
